Common Questions

How do you organize a pedestal sink with zero counter space?

Use a wall-mounted adhesive toothbrush caddy, an over-the-toilet storage rack, and a slim 6-inch rolling cart tucked right beside the sink.

What materials hold up best in humid small bathrooms?

Rustproof coated aluminum, clear acrylic, silicone, and sealed bamboo hold up far better than uncoated steel or cardboard.
